_readme: Dog dermatology market — Poland. A TOP-DOWN ESTIMATE built entirely from free/public
sources. No public source measures this market directly, so every headline number here
is MODELLED, not observed. This file is the single reproducible source for the study page
dog-derm-poland.html — every figure on that page recomputes from the inputs below.
Cut-off: 5 Aug 2026. Author: pipeline in this repository.

fx.note: EUR/PLN ~4.30, 2024-2025 average band (4.2-4.4). Used only to express PLN results in EUR; the model is built in PLN.

dog_population.source: FEDIAF Facts & Figures 2025 (2023 pet population data)
dog_population.note: 4th largest dog population in the EU; highest per-capita dog ownership in Europe (~49% of households). Polish trade press rounds to 8.0M.

derm_episode_rate_per_year.unit: share of the dog population with a vet-attended dermatological episode per year
derm_episode_rate_per_year.source_proxy: UK VetCompass primary-care data: skin disorders ~12.6% one-year period prevalence (2nd most common disorder group); otitis externa ~7.3%. General-practice caseload surveys put dermatology at 8-40% of small-animal consultations (UK 21.4%, Montreal 18.8%).
derm_episode_rate_per_year.PROXY_LIMITATION: No Polish national prevalence dataset exists. UK/Western-European prevalence is applied to the Polish dog population. This assumption travels with every number derived from it. Polish figures could differ due to breed mix, climate, and treatment-seeking behaviour.

annual_derm_spend_per_treated_dog_pln.unit: PLN per treated dog per year (blended across simple and chronic cases)
annual_derm_spend_per_treated_dog_pln.source_proxy: Built from Polish public price points: standard vet consultation 100-250 PLN (PETHELP/Vivigo 2024-25 price surveys); Apoquel 16mg ~46-90 PLN per 20-tablet pack (Allegro listings, 2026); diagnostics (skin scrape/cytology, USG ~160 PLN, faecal ~100 PLN). A simple episode (1 consult + short topical course) ~150-400 PLN; a chronic atopic case (long-term Apoquel/Cytopoint + repeat consults + diagnostics) ~1,500-4,000 PLN/yr. Blend is dominated by simple cases with a chronic minority.
annual_derm_spend_per_treated_dog_pln.note: Blended average, NOT a chronic-case cost.

poland_vet_services_market.source: IBISWorld Veterinary Services in Poland (~EUR 1.4bn, 2026); Ken Research Poland Animal Health & Veterinary (~USD 0.9-1.5bn); Eurostat/reportlinker production value EUR 827.6M (2023) rising to ~EUR 997M by 2028.
poland_vet_services_market.note: Whole veterinary market — includes farm/livestock work, not companion-animal only.

companion_animal_share.note: Assumed share of the vet-services market that is companion animals (Poland retains a sizeable food-animal veterinary sector).

dog_share_of_companion.note: Dogs vs cats/other; dogs ~47-52% of the pet population but higher share of clinical spend.

derm_share_of_canine_clinical_spend.note: Dermatology as a share of canine clinical REVENUE. Lower than its ~15-25% share of consultation VOLUME because derm visits are on average cheaper than surgery/dentistry.

results._method: Bottom-up: dogs x derm_episode_rate x annual_spend_per_treated_dog. Envelope: vet market x companion share x dog share x derm revenue share. Both in PLN then / 4.30 for EUR.

reconciled_central_band_eur_million.note: Overlap of the two independent methods. Reported as the honest central estimate; the wider bottom-up range (EUR 45-271M) is the outer bound.

veterinary_facilities.unit: licensed animal-treatment establishments (zaklady lecznicze dla zwierzat)
veterinary_facilities.source: Krajowa Izba Lekarsko-Weterynaryjna (National Chamber) / WetSystems register; ~72% are clinics, avg ~1.5 vets each. Business-directory counts run higher (8,800 IBISWorld; ~12,700 CompanyData) because they include all registered vet businesses.
veterinary_facilities.note: Free, public, complete national register at wetsystems.org.pl — countable by voivodeship and identifiable by derm specialism.

regional_concentration.note: Mazovia (Warsaw) leads with ~1,691 vet businesses, then Greater Poland ~850, Silesia ~666, Lower Silesia ~612 (business-directory basis).

sources.what: Prevalence of commonly diagnosed disorders in UK dogs under primary veterinary care
Survey of prevalence, diagnosis and treatment of dermatological conditions in small animals in general practice
Veterinary Services in Poland — industry data
Cost of a Polish vet visit, 2024-2025 price survey

paid_vendors.gives: Actual pharmaceutical sales through the vet channel and patient visits/spend by therapeutic area, monthly, by country — the only real measured source for Polish derm-drug sales.
Country-level veterinary dermatology drug outlook (Poland cut available).
Polish pet ownership, spend and channels; weak on pharma specifics.
